items.q: George Hudson worked with Jeter Pillars’s band at one time, yeah. James Jeter was a lead alto [saxophone] player...

ctx.x: Did George Hudson come out of Jeter-Pillars?

George Hudson worked with Jeter Pillars’s band at one time, yeah. James Jeter was a lead alto [saxophone] player, and Hayes Pillars was a tenor [saxophone] player. His brother Charles Pillars played baritone [saxophone]. That was a nice band they had too.
